check.source: Antony Green (ABC) notional margins, as tabulated in the Wikipedia pre-election pendulums (2022 Victorian state election; Pre-election pendulum for the 2025 Australian federal election), retrieved 2026-11-08. pseudo_replication.note: Counting every seat as its own observation, though all share one sky on the day: the naive p-value is tiny; allowing for seats within an election moving together, it is not.

joint_shuffle.note: all clubs' seasons shuffled together across elections; hits = club x group x contrast pairs with |r| above the p<0.05 threshold

joint_shuffle_within_level.note: state v federal means removed from form and swings; seasons shuffled only among elections of the same level
